articles.headline: Mukesh Ambani's Jio Seeks Record $108 Billion Valuation
articles.brief: Reliance Industries' telecom arm Jio is targeting a massive $108 billion valuation in what is expected to be a record-breaking initial public offering in the Indian stock market.

articles.headline: Canada's Fairfax Buys Majority Stake in IDBI Bank
articles.brief: Canadian investment firm Fairfax Financial has acquired a majority stake in IDBI Bank for a substantial $5.56 billion, marking a significant milestone in Indian banking investments.

articles.headline: Asian Markets Sell Off After Hot US CPI Data
articles.brief: Stock markets across Asia tumbled significantly as technology and AI trades crumbled in response to hotter-than-expected US Consumer Price Index inflation figures.

articles.headline: Reliance Enters Dairy Market With Joyland Flavoured Milk
articles.brief: Reliance Consumer Products has launched Joyland flavoured milk priced competitively at ₹20, triggering a fresh retail war with established players like Amul, ITC, and Mother Dairy.

articles.headline: Bank of America Spent Millions Containing AI Agent Threat
articles.brief: Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan revealed that the financial institution spent millions of dollars and hired thousands of contractors to mitigate security risks from Anthropic's Mythos AI agent.

articles.headline: NTPC Seeks ₹1.5-Trillion Rosatom Tie-Up for Nuclear Reactors
articles.brief: State-run power generator NTPC has pitched for six unbuilt nuclear reactors under a bilateral framework, targeting an ambitious 30GW of nuclear energy capacity by 2047.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Likely to Hear Plea Against SIR Today
articles.brief: The Supreme Court of India is scheduled to hear petitions filed by prominent political leaders challenging recent administrative actions and ongoing street protests.

articles.headline: US Considers Easing Sanctions on Shadow Fleet Vessels
articles.brief: The US administration is reportedly weighing options to ease certain sanctions on shadow fleet oil tankers in an effort to cool soaring global freight rates.

articles.headline: Oil Prices Fall as Investors Weigh Middle East Tensions
articles.brief: Crude oil futures dropped as market participants re-evaluated supply outlooks and potential security threats near vital Middle Eastern shipping lanes.

articles.headline: Two Ships Sink Near Strait of Hormuz Amid Attacks
articles.brief: Maritime security agencies confirmed that two commercial vessels have sunk near the Strait of Hormuz following an intensification of attacks on shipping traffic.

articles.headline: Team India ODI Squad for New Zealand Tour Expected Soon
articles.brief: The interim national selection committee headed by Pragyan Ojha is set to announce India's squad for the upcoming limited-overs tour of New Zealand.

articles.headline: IMF Applauds India's GDP Data Revamp and Fundamentals
articles.brief: The International Monetary Fund praised India's recent economic data restructuring, highlighting that the country navigated global energy shocks backed by robust macroeconomic fundamentals.

articles.headline: US Teen Arrested Over Alleged Mass Shooting Plot on Temple
articles.brief: A 19-year-old US resident expressing white supremacist views was taken into federal custody after authorities intercepted an alleged plot targeting a Hindu temple in Illinois.
